description: Temporary admission rules for a foreign-plated vehicle in one country: allowed days, per entry or per window, carnet requirement, green card. A country without a rule we can stand behind returns nothing rather than a guess.

country.description: Country: ISO alpha-2 code, slug or zone code, e.g. georgia or GE.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: get_vehicle_import_rules
title: Temporary Vehicle Import Rules
